literal_meaning: খুঁট (stake or post), আখুরে (related to horse's hoof), বরাখুরে (large or worthless hoof-like thing)
figurative_meaning_en: Useless and worthless, good for nothing
similar_in_english: Useless as tits on a bull
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তো খুঁট আখুরে বরাখুরে, কোনো কাজে লাগবে না।
এই ছেলেটা খুঁট আখুরে বরাখুরে, সবসময় অলস।
example_sentences_in_english: He's just a good-for-nothing, won't be useful for anything.
That guy is useless as tits on a bull, always lazy.
note: This idiom uses rustic, animal-related imagery typical of Bengali folk expressions to demean someone's worthlessness.
